title: Fallout 3 Janus Bear Spatial Enrichment Hardening — Cell-Stratified Exact Test and Geometry Ceiling

interpretation.128: local spatial proximity on roughly one-human-height scale
interpretation.512: broad local neighborhood; not automatically one visible scene

population_correction.admitted_target: four static generic skeleton proxy base records already bound by v4.0

cell_stratified_exact_test.name: EXACT_CONDITIONAL_CELL_STRATIFIED_HYPERGEOMETRIC_CONVOLUTION
cell_stratified_exact_test.null_model: Within each exact location_key, teddy labels are exchangeable only among teddy plus ordinary MISC control positions while the number of teddy labels and near-skeleton positions in that location are fixed.
cell_stratified_exact_test.per_stratum: X_i ~ Hypergeom(N_i, K_i, n_i), where N_i = teddy+MISC candidate positions, K_i = positions within threshold of a static skeleton proxy, n_i = teddy count.
cell_stratified_exact_test.global_statistic: X = sum_i X_i; exact null distribution obtained by deterministic convolution of all stratum PMFs.
cell_stratified_exact_test.primary_alternative: teddies are enriched near static skeleton proxies
cell_stratified_exact_test.reason: Prevents cells with unusually many skeletons, teddies or generic clutter from manufacturing a pooled global enrichment signal through composition alone.

geometry_hardening.problem: Euclidean same-cell distance does not know walls, floors, doors or line of sight.

synthetic_adversarial_cases.expected: single-cell 4/4 teddy-near vs 1/20 control-near produces exact enrichment p = C(5,4)/C(24,4)
pooled risk ratio can exceed 10 while exact cell-stratified p remains 1.0 when each cell itself contains no teddy-position preference
500-unit vertical separation can still satisfy broad 512-unit 3D radius but fails the <=128 vertical sensitivity band and never establishes same scene
static skeleton proxy measurement cannot be promoted to all human remains

inference_priority: pooled same-cell MISC risk ratio and two-sided Fisher as descriptive secondary statistics

decision_matrix.strong_stratified_enrichment_and_stable_: supports recurring spatial placement grammar around static skeleton proxies
decision_matrix.pooled_enrichment_but_stratified_null: supports cell-composition confounding, not global teddy preference
decision_matrix.effect_disappears_under_vertical_sensiti: suggests cross-floor/cross-geometry proximity inflated broad 512-unit signal
decision_matrix.no_global_enrichment_but_known_dioramas_: specific intentional scenes survive; global grammar not established
decision_matrix.strong_teddy_gnome_but_weak_teddy_skelet: supports miniature social/diorama grammar more than tragedy-witness grammar
decision_matrix.strong_gnome_skeleton_independent_of_ted: supports macabre gnome proxy-actor grammar deserving a separate reference graph

next_gate.name: EXACT_HEAD_CI_THEN_OFFICIAL_ESM_REFERENCE_EXPORT
requirements: GitHub Actions explicitly checks out PR head rather than synthetic merge ref
all v4.2 stratified/geometry adversarial tests pass
official master TSV remains absent from CI and therefore real percentages remain unknown
